meta.name: portfolio-strategy
meta.description: Decides where capital and attention go across business lines, products, and markets — what to fund, hold, harvest, or exit, and on what evidence. Use this to allocate budget across businesses, evaluate whether a product line should continue, decide whether to exit one, structure a portfolio review, or when several initiatives compete for the same limited investment.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理清业务线投资优先级，决定追加还是退出
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常要在多个业务或产品间分配预算，犹豫是否砍掉某个产品线
copy.tagline_en: Prioritize business lines and decide where to invest or exit.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often allocate budget across businesses and hesitate to cut a product line

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会帮你按两条轴评估每条业务线，判断该资助、谨慎进入、收割还是退出；并用边际回报而非绝对规模决定投入，同时指导你规划退出和定期评审组合。
howto.when: 当你想让 Claude 在多个业务或项目间分配预算、评估某条产品线要不要继续做、或决定是否退出某项业务时触发。

say.text: 帮我评估这两条业务线，按吸引力和获胜权打分。
say.note: 会得到每条线对应的资助、收割等姿态。

say.text: 按边际回报对比 A 项目和 B 项目，该追加给谁钱？
say.note: 会依据下一块钱的回报来比较，而非看当前规模。

say.text: 我们想退出 C 业务，帮我规划个干净利落的退出方案。
say.note: 会考虑客户承诺、员工安置和合同义务。

howto.what_en: Guides capital and attention allocation across business lines. Scores each line on attractiveness and right-to-win, assigns a posture (fund, hold, harvest, exit), judges by marginal return, and helps plan exits and portfolio reviews.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to allocate budget across businesses or initiatives, evaluate whether a product line should continue, decide whether to exit one, or structure a portfolio review.

say_en.text: Evaluate these two business lines on attractiveness and right to win.
say_en.note: You'll get a recommended posture for each.

say_en.text: Compare Project A and B by marginal return — where should the extra dollar go?
say_en.note: Judges by next-dollar impact, not current size.

say_en.text: Help us exit the C business cleanly.
say_en.note: Covers customer, employee, and contract obligations.
